description: SOPPA! by Future Crew, a 64K intro for Assembly '94 that failed the party's pre-selection, running from its original files in your browser.
about: SOPPA! is Future Crew's 64K intro for the PC 64K intro competition at Assembly '94, held from 5 to 7 August 1994 in Helsinki. It failed the competition's pre-selection and was not shown.
Its program is 65,535 bytes. It opens on about 10 seconds of black while its music starts, runs for about two minutes and returns to DOS.
This is the party's copy, with Future Crew's information files of July 1994.
released: Assembly '94: entered in the PC 64K intro competition, it failed the pre-selection and was not shown. SOPPA.EXE is dated 6 August 1994.
credits: Code by Psi, music by Purple Motion (“Kermavaahto (aka. Soppaaa)”), graphics by Marvel, as Demozoo credits them.
terms: Future Crew's information file in its archive makes all their demos freeware: “you can copy and distribute them freely as long as you make no modifications to them.” (FCINFO16.TXT)
accuracy: It plays through the Gravis UltraSound DosKit gives it. On the Sound Blaster 16 alone, its pauses stretch it from about 128 to about 150 seconds.
Its timeline is within about a second of a 128-second capture whose hardware is not stated.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: SOPPA!'s title picture, a bowl of soup, running in DosKit
